stories.title: Russian cargo vessel hit by drone in Gulf of Finland
stories.summary: A Russian cargo ship, the Sparta II, was struck by a drone on Saturday while en route to the Kaliningrad exclave and drifted into Finnish waters. Finnish defence officials said Ukraine was likely responsible. Rescue and firefighting teams from Finland, Estonia and Russia continued to work on Sunday, using water to keep the vessel from sinking, and reported no danger to nearby traffic.
stories.why: The incident shows the vulnerability of commercial shipping in the Baltic region to drone attacks and the risk of wider geopolitical tension.
